evals.prompt: I finished my feature on branch feat/login and pushed it. Create a pull request against main with title 'Add login flow', then after CI passes merge it with squash and delete the branch.
evals.expected_output: Uses `gh pr create` with title/head/base flags, then `gh pr merge` with squash and delete-branch, all non-interactively.
assertions: no bare `gh pr create` without title flags

evals.prompt: List the 10 most recently updated open issues in cli/cli, showing just their numbers and titles as JSON.
evals.expected_output: A `gh issue list -R cli/cli` call with `--json number,title` and `--limit 10`, parsing JSON output instead of text.
assertions: command includes `--json` with number and title

evals.prompt: Use the GitHub API to find my login name via GraphQL.
evals.expected_output: A `gh api graphql` query for the viewer login, without hand-rolling curl with tokens.

evals.prompt: Run the deploy workflow in the current repo at ref v1.2.3 with input env=staging.
evals.expected_output: A `gh workflow run deploy.yml -r v1.2.3 -f env=staging` invocation.

evals.prompt: Set the secret DEPLOY_KEY for the current repo's production environment, reading the value from the environment variable.
evals.expected_output: A `gh secret set DEPLOY_KEY --env production --body "$DEPLOY_KEY"` call that avoids echoing the secret on the command line in CI.
